verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, a CRUD API for performing console.statsig.com actions without the web UI. It ships a versioned, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec, a header-selected versioning scheme with a non-breaking guarantee, and in-page live 'Try it' runners. A separate HTTP API covers gate/experiment evaluation and event logging. The probe's 404s on docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec is published at a versioned api.statsig.com path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through the Console API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
